English: Stone Marker
A simple sacred stone marker, denoting a gathering place for the clan and serving as a symbolic center during migration.
Stepped Mound
A low, earthen mound with primitive steps, used for communal rituals and as a visible sign of unity for the wandering clan.
Temple Platform
A raised stone platform, signifying the emergence of more permanent sacred spaces for rituals and clan gatherings.
Priests Chamber
A small, stone-walled chamber for the priesthood, providing a place for sacred texts, relics, and the stewards of ritual.
Altar Stand
A modest altar atop the temple platform, used for offerings and rites, fostering growing religious devotion among the people.
Sanctuary Pavilion
A large decorated pavilion, sheltering important clan relics and serving as a focus for communal prayers and unity.
Holy Room
A secluded, stone-lined holy room, where only the highest priests may enter. Used for vital clan ceremonies and decisions.
Diviners Hall
A grand hall where diviners interpret omens and advise chieftains, strengthening clan cohesion and spiritual unity.
Sanctified Chamber
A vast sanctified chamber, echoing with chanting and rituals, centralizing the clans spiritual heart and authority.
Grand Sacred Pyramid
A monumental stepped pyramid, visible for miles, serving as the spiritual and political summit of the nomadic Mesoamerican clan.
